main_text.p: bant, eandem circumeuntes, ac discurrentes, singulásq; stationes obeuntes, & lapides [in Menah] conjicientes. Tertio quoque anno mensem intercalabant, post congressum lavabant, frequenter os & nares abluebant, capillos discriminabant, dentes fricabant, ab excrementis emissis se mundabant, ungues præscabant, pubem radebant, furi dextram amputabant. Ex iis autem quæ è medio tollenda censuit, aliquorum jam supra mentionem fecimus, aliis hunc in locum rejectis; cujus promissi fide nisi teneremur, hic manum de tabulâ (utpote longiùs quam putaveramus, provecti) libenter tolleremus. Quantum ergo ei liberandæ sufficere videatur, ad alias quasdam Arabum confuetudines (eas præcipue quarum in Alcorano cæterisque Mohammedis dictis mentio) digitum intendemus. quod genus sunt illæ inprimis; quas isto, quod p. 136. innuimus, præcepto vetuit لا عدوى ولا طيرة ولا صفر ولا هامة Nou est [vel, ne fit vobis] Adwa nec Tirab, nec Safar, nec Hamah, quorum primum العدوى (explicante Ebnol Athir) proprie sonat contagium, sc. ut ab aliquo morbo affecto, transferatur in alium مثل ما يصاحب simile illi quod patitur morbo isto affectus, ut cum (inquit) Camelum scabie affectum cum aliis miscer ri non patiantur, metu ne in illos transeat, quæ in ipso est; scabies. وقد ابطله الاسلام hoc autem credi aut timeri vetuit Islamismus, quoniam credere vis funi ipsum morbum [ab uno in alium] transire; docente Mohammede, non ita se rem habere, sed Deum esse qui ægritudinem & morbum immittat. Quod ad لا صفر non Safar, duplicem affert idem ejus interpretationem;AlMoftarra.et AlDamiri in صفر &c.مجاوزة من صاحبه الى غيره AlKimus,v & Kimus & AlDamiri.

page.notes: Marginal notes are partly Arabic and partly illegible in the scan; the Arabic readings in the notes and the Arabic in the text (e.g. مثل ما يصاحب, لا عدوى) are approximate and should be checked against the original. The left-margin notes are placed beside the lines where they stand; the exact Arabic in the second note is uncertain: "مجاوزة من صاحبه الى غيره" is inferred. The note "v & Kimus" is uncertain in its first letter. The Arabic in the line "وقد ابطله الاسلام" is uncertain. The word "scabie" is set with a hyphen-like break in the scan ("miscer-ri"), read as "miscere ri" where the scan shows "miscer- ri"; the printed text is taken as "miscere ri" per the scan. No catchword, signature or footer visible. Line 2 of the left margin "صفر &c." is uncertain.
